The one backend FAILURE is a real, reproducible INFEASIBILITY in POST /api/rotas/{id}/generate when D.A. is put on AL for >=2 consecutive days in week 2 — even though the same scenario succeeds via the standalone solver (test_runner.py OPTIMAL, T.D.=72h/wk2). critical.issue: Returns 422 INFEASIBLE when D.A. is on AL for >=2 consecutive days (e.g. problem-statement scenario: D.A. AL 2026-04-27..2026-05-03). Reproduced with 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7-day AL spans — all INFEASIBLE. Setting `non_flexi_overage` to soft via PUT /api/rules makes the exact same 7-day scenario OPTIMAL. The standalone solver via solver/test_runner.py succeeds because the seed file does NOT include `non_flexi_overage` in its rules dict, so that hard constraint is skipped. The main agent's pre-test 'T.D.=72h week 2' result was obtained via the standalone runner, NOT via the HTTP endpoint — so the BUG FIX #4 (flexi redistribution per-week) is NOT verifiable through the real API under the current default rule set. Fix options: (a) downgrade non_flexi_overage to soft in db_seeder defaults, (b) exempt the solver from the cap when contracted-hours-min would otherwise be infeasible, (c) increase the +8h cap, or (d) relax the cap on the AL-affected week.

rca_of_the_issue: POST /api/rotas/{id}/generate returns INFEASIBLE when D.A. has multi-day AL in week 2 because the solver is built from MongoDB rules_config (solver_input_builder.py:26-49) which contains `non_flexi_overage: {mode: hard, weight: 50}`. Combined with the new hard per-week `contracted_hours_min` (target-2 each week) and the unchanged hard `manager_no_shifts`, the LP for that week demands every non-flexi staff fill their weekly min of (target-2) AND stay <= target+8, while the single remaining Flexi (T.D.) must pick up the rest. The CP-SAT cannot find an assignment that satisfies capability + consecutive-shift + per-shift med/first-aider + non_flexi_overage all at once. Standalone test_runner.py masks this bug because its seed JSON (backend/seed/grizedale.json line `rules`) does NOT declare `non_flexi_overage` at all, so that constraint is simply not generated by the solver. Mitigation: change non_flexi_overage mode to 'soft' in db_seeder.py migration (line ~117 rules_config) and existing DB rows, OR increase the +8h cap to +12h, OR exempt the week containing a 7-day AL for a flexi staff. Repro: PUT /api/rules with non_flexi_overage.mode=soft → the same D.A. 7-day AL scenario returns OPTIMAL and T.D. week-2 hours jump above her average (verified live during this test iteration).
